dedupe_keys.name: plastic injection moulding with deliberately induced drying faults sirris cycle level dataset

description: This record holds a labelled industrial dataset for detecting material-drying faults in plastic injection moulding, with the pre-processing and modelling code. The Zenodo page says data came from an Arburg 420C Golden Edition machine at the Sirris industrial facility, with cycle-level process parameters read from the machine controller over OPC-UA, a Kistler ComoNeo system, thermocouples on the mould halves and MQTT environmental sensors, giving about 75 process variables per moulded piece. There are nine production runs with 5,001 pieces in 83 batches, some made with deliberately under-dried hygroscopic polymer. Version 1.0.0 was published on 24 August 2026 as downloadable CSV files per test run and cleaned batch tables, a variable dictionary, overview tables, figures and a code archive; the data is free under CC BY 4.0 and the code under MIT. Coverage is one machine at one facility in Belgium. Caveats: it is a single-machine experiment, so fault rates do not represent a real plant, and energy use and cycle timing across a whole line are not stated on the page read. For simulation it supports anomaly detection and predictive quality models for manufacturing digital twins, and testing how process faults propagate to scrap and downtime in production-line models. Related catalogue records include the NASA Prognostics data repository and the ICS SCADA cyber testbed traffic data.
